verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a Sandbox mode where a fixed set of test inputs deterministically produces successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks, and it supports custom test users from your organization. The evidence only shows magic values for the success path, though, not for fail or review outcomes. missing for 10: documented magic values or personas that deterministically produce fail and pending-review results, coverage of other checks such as liveness and risk, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results

citations.quote: In Sandbox mode, Identity Verification accepts the fixed set of inputs below in order to result in successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks.
Plaid supports creating custom test users from your organization directly in Sandbox.
